image_pattern_summary: Verified good portable cabin images consistently show the complete cabin exterior from a front-facing or slight three-quarter angle, with corrugated steel or panel walls, visible windows (typically aluminium-framed sliding type), a steel door, and a flat or slightly sloped roof. Images are taken either outdoors in a yard/site context or against a plain white background for clean product shots. The full footprint and height of the cabin are visible, allowing buyers to assess size, construction quality, and finish.

reason: Portable cabin images show the physical structure — exterior walls, doors, windows, and roof — where the product appearance itself communicates construction quality, size, and finish to the buyer.
No meaningful text is printed or labelled on the cabin exterior that OCR could extract (one exception: item 170449061 has a product code label, but this is atypical and not buyer-critical).
Buyers assess portable cabins visually by structure type, panel finish, and overall dimensions — OCR extraction would not add value beyond what the image already communicates.
